candidates.old:
LDA movers_type_and_colour,X
    AND #&7F
    TAY
    LDA movers_frame_and_flip,X
    AND #&7F
    CMP #&0D                        \ MOVER_TYPE_SKELETON
    BEQ skeleton_height             \ grind: the common case falls through
.use_height_table
    LDA mover_types_height_table,Y
    RTS
.skeleton_height
    LDA #&11
    RTS

.check_for_mover_Y_collision_with_player    \ # Called with X = 0 (MOVER_PLAYER)
    JSR get_mover_Y_x_and_y
    TAY
    LDA mover_x_low
    BNE set_first_mover             \ Always branches
.check_for_mover_collision_with_movers
    LDX #&17                        \ MOVER_LAST_PROJECTILE
.set_first_mover
    STX first_mover
    LDX #&FF                        \ MOVER_PLAYER - 1
    STX last_mover
    LDX mover_to_update
    STA mover_x_low
    STY &C5
    STY mover_x_max_high            \ grind: what calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max's first two do
    JSR calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max + 4 \ past LDA &C5 : STA mover_x_max_high (2 + 2 bytes)
    LDX first_mover
.check_for_mover_collision_with_range_of_movers
    \ Step 2 (layer 3): a mover right of the range, or left of it even at the widest type, cannot
    \ collide, and is passed over without check_for_mover_collision_with_mover_X looking up its
    \ type, width and height - except in the last two checks: the last one that runs (the last
    \ is skipped if it is mover_to_update) leaves A, Y, &78 and &7A as the original did. Worked
    \ out once a search: those two are X < last_mover + 3; the left edge is the range's left
    \ less the widest type (0 if that is below 0). A and C here are the loop's to set.
    LDA last_mover
    CLC
    ADC #3
    STA cm_full_below_operand       \ grind: cm_full_below lives in the CPX's operand
    LDA mover_x_max_low             \ grind: and the range's right (low) in the LDA's
    STA cm_x_max_low_operand
    LDA mover_x_max_high            \ grind: and its right (high) in the SBC's LDA (nothing in the loop writes it)

LDA movers_type_and_colour,X
    AND #&7F
    TAY
    LDA movers_frame_and_flip,X
    EOR #&0D                        \ grind: MOVER_TYPE_SKELETON (&0D, either flip): frame AND &7F = &0D <=> (frame EOR &0D) ASL 1 = 0
    ASL A                           \ (C is dead on every exit: its one caller CLCs before it next reads it)
    BEQ skeleton_height             \ grind: the common case falls through
.use_height_table
    LDA mover_types_height_table,Y
    RTS
.skeleton_height
    LDA #&11
    RTS

    STA cm_x_max_low_operand
    LDA #&17 + 3                    \ last_mover + 3: cm_full_below lives in the CPX's operand
    BRA cm_set_full_below_g5

candidates.summary: The movers' collision search (check_for_mover_collision_with_movers, ~3.5 calls a pass) sets cm_full_below_operand (the CPX #'s operand) and cm_x_max_low_operand from what it already knows: A = mover_x_max_low as calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max returns it (no LDA zp) and last_mover + 3 = 2 as a constant (LDA #2 for LDA zp/CLC/ADC #3), 21 cycles become 13 an execution. The rare range entry (helicopter boarding) moves out of line in front of the player's entry, stores its own operands (low from mover_x_max_low, &17 + 3) and BRAs into the shared STA cm_full_below_operand: +3 cycles on a path that runs once per boarding attempt. Also get_mover_X_type_and_height's skeleton test as LDA frame / EOR #&0D / ASL A / BEQ (Z iff frame AND &7F = &0D), one byte shorter, same 4 cycles. Net +3 bytes (the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW and SKY_HELI=0 builds have 4 free there; +7 or more fails their 'layer 1' ASSERT). Measured on a scratch build (bench layout, unclobbered): logic 9440 -> 9412 a pass (seed 1, 1500 passes), 10255 -> 10226 (RIGHT, 600); render and interrupts unchanged. Alternatives: candidate 2 (same without the EOR byte, +4) and candidate 3 (the EOR byte alone); this overlaps both.
candidates.equivalence: Hot path (JSR check_for_mover_collision_with_movers; the player's BNE set_first_mover path unchanged): every store the old code made is still made with the same value before anything reads it: cm_x_max_low_operand = mover_x_max_low (A after the callee, equal to the old LDA mover_x_max_low), cm_full_below_operand = last_mover + 3 = 2 (old: &FF + 3 = 2 mod 256, carry out dead), X = first_mover (LDX before the STA/LDA, which do not touch X), then LDA mover_x_max_high as before. Order of the three operand stores is immaterial (set_cm_left, the next call, reads none of them). Flags at exit: A, N, Z from the same LDA mover_x_max_high; C differs (old 1, new whatever the callee left) and is dead: set_cm_left begins LDA zp / SEC. Rare path: old entered at the label with last_mover = &17: LDA last_mover/CLC/ADC #3 = &1A -> cm_full_below_operand, then x_max_low -> its operand, then LDA high. New entry does the same stores (low operand first, &1A to cm_full_below_operand) and joins at STA cm_full_below_operand; X, Y untouched as before (X = &21 is the search's start). Its one caller is JSR at game.6502:3049. Skeleton test: frame EOR &0D then ASL A is zero iff (frame EOR &0D) AND &7F = 0 iff frame AND &7F = &0D, so BEQ takes exactly when CMP #&0D did; A and Y at both exits are reloaded (table / #&11) before RTS; C differs from CMP's but its only caller (check_for_collision_with_mover, STA &78 / LDA width,Y / STA &7A / CLC) never reads it. Checked by passlock seeds 1 (6000) and 3 (4000), the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW oracle seed 5, helilock 5 and 2 (boards a helicopter: runs the rare entry), frontend and observer: all identical.
candidates.relies_on: calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max's RTS leaves A = mover_x_max_low (its last store is STA mover_x_max_low); check_for_mover_collision_with_range_of_movers has exactly one caller (enter_or_leave_helicopter, game.6502:3049) and it sets last_mover = &17 immediately before, so last_mover + 3 = &1A there; on the movers' and player's path last_mover = &FF is stored just above and nothing between writes it, so last_mover + 3 = 2 (mod 256); set_cm_left (JSR, first thing after the window) starts LDA/SEC so the carry the window leaves is dead; nothing reads first_mover but this routine. Page crossings: code after the window slides +3 bytes (the collision loop &24C9-&24F6 -> &24CC-&24F9 stays inside page &24; set_cm_left and calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max stay inside page &25's start); I listed every branch in the build whose page-cross status differs at a +3 shift: none is hot (no hot branch or table read newly crosses); get_mover_X_type_and_height itself does not move. Free space: +3 bytes in game.6502's main block before SKIP unused_3400_original (193 free in the bench build, 4 free in the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW and SKY_HELI=0 builds: all builds assemble).

Only C differs (old: frame AND &7F >= &0D; new: bit 7 of the EOR result) and it is dead: the only JSR (check_for_collision_with_mover, game.6502:3622) does STA &78 / LDA width,Y / STA &7A / CLC before anything reads C.
